key_provisions_or_claims: Project investigates how cobot-based workplaces can promote workers' mental health
Aims to produce organisational guidelines for mental-health-friendly cobot workplaces
Aims to produce technical design guidelines and a prototype for mental-health-friendly cobots
Aims to define an employment model for persons with autism spectrum disorders in manufacturing SMEs using cobots
EU contribution of about EUR 3.9 million under Horizon 2020
annotation.summary_en: CORDIS fact sheet for the Horizon 2020 MindBot project (2020–2023, coordinated from Italy). It studies how cobot-based manufacturing workplaces in SMEs can promote workers' mental health. Expected outputs are organisational and technical design guidelines and an employment model for people with autism. The page is informational and not a governance instrument.
